Autonomous Mode vs Supervised Mode in Kiro

Which mode should you actually be using?
Autonomous mode lets Kiro's agents work independently through a task.
Supervised mode keeps you approving each step as it happens.
Use autonomous for routine work, supervised for anything high-stakes.
